test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Numerical Ability (Held on: 02 Dec, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: Ram and Shyam together can complete a work in 12 days. Shyam alone can complete the work in 15 days. Shyam alone worked for 5 days. After that, how long will Ram alone take to complete the work?
solution:
**Given:**

Ram and Shyam together can complete the work in 12 days.

Shyam alone can complete the work in 15 days.

Shyam alone worked for 5 days.

**Formula Used:**

Work done by both together in 1 day = 1/12

Work done by Shyam alone in 1 day = 1/15

Work done by Ram alone in 1 day = 1/12 - 1/15

Remaining work after Shyam worked for 5 days = Total work - Work done by Shyam in 5 days

Time taken by Ram to complete the remaining work = Remaining work / Work done by Ram in 1 day

Calcula
